title: —We’ll be choked, Buck Mulligan said. Haines, open that door, will you?
html_source: Though the fireplace Mulligan cooks over vents to the outside, and there are two narrow open slits in the wall (which the narrator calls “barbacans”, originally designed for shooting muskets through), there is clearly very little ventilation in the tiny tower. Mulligan’s greasy fried eggs over coal fire quickly fill the chamber with smoke, requiring opening the heavy iron door to the outside.
